svg.text: Pi 3B+ 40-pin header, looking down on the board with pin 1 at the SD-card end. Every used pin in its net colour; every CAT5e core traced terminal -> sensor.
board edge to the RIGHT (even pins), SD-card end at the top
square = wired on the HAT · dashed = spare rail pin worth bonding
Pi 3B+ has 1k8 pull-ups on pins 3/5 already - add none.
Two joints per conductor and nothing between: screw terminal in the box, solder + heatshrink at the sensor. Cable is cheaper than a roof trip.
SOLDER TO AT THE FAR END
from the buck / adapter, OUTSIDE the box
Sensor pins at the far end
VCC -> gn DATA -> bl GND -> gn/wh. 3.3 V supply on purpose: keeps DATA at 3.3 V logic and off the heater rail.
VCC -> or GND -> or/wh AOUT -> br (MQ-7) / br/wh (MQ-135). DOUT unused. Heaters ~150 mA each - hence their own pair.
VCC -> gn GND -> gn/wh AO -> bl/wh. At 3.3 V its AO is already 0-3.3 V: straight into CH3, no divider.
red -> or black -> or/wh yellow -> bl. R1 4k7 DATA->3V3 lives on the HAT, not at the probe.
VCC -> or GND -> or/wh AOUT -> gn. Pot the top 25 mm. Calibrated at 3.3 V (SOIL_DRY 4021) - keep it on 3.3 V.
Generated by scripts/gen_drawings.py from the same net list as sheets 1 and 2.
